subject.title: Allow owners and authors to delete messages

question: Should workspace owners be allowed to soft-delete any non-DM channel or thread message while direct messages remain author-only?
rationale: The patch correctly implements a coherent boundary, but choosing who receives destructive moderation authority is a repository policy decision rather than a correctness question automation can settle.

options.title: Approve owner-only moderation
options.body: Accept the implemented model in which authors delete their own messages and workspace owners may moderate non-DM messages.

options.title: Keep deletion author-only
options.body: Remove the owner exception and retain the existing rule that only each message author may delete it.

recommendation.title: Approve owner-only moderation
recommendation.body: Accept the implemented model in which authors delete their own messages and workspace owners may moderate non-DM messages.
